rca_of_issue: Previous bug: doEndMatch in match.tsx was calling PUT /api/matches/{id} with an events array containing only text-based events (like 'GOAL! Player (1-0)'), which overwrote the structured events (with type, player_id, minute, detail). Fix: doEndMatch now posts the full_time event separately via POST /api/matches/{id}/events and only updates status/score via PUT. This preserves all structured events logged during the match.
